blocks.html: ROBINSONS PLACE LAS PIÑAS CELEBRATES WORLD ANIMAL DAY 2015

Robinsons Malls gives its shoppers another meaningful malling experience as Robinsons Place Las Piñas holds a fun filled and informational event in celebration of the international World Animal Day on October 4 at the Grand Atrium. The World Animal Day, also celebrated during the Feast Day of St. Francis of Assisi, aims to raise the awareness of animal welfare, empower animal advocates and actively involve people in animal rights.

Robinsons Malls together with The Advocacy Center Philippines and Metro South Pack Group give back and honor animal life by giving shoppers and pet owners a series of amusing activities such as the pet blessing; pets in costume parade; poster making contest; and a variety games for pets and pet owners. To further get the community involved and fully-informed, the event will also give enlightening talks which will tackle truths and myths on Rabies; understanding cat and dog behaviors; helping pets and the environment; and achieving a sustainable life with pets.

To know more about the event, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or download the Robinsons App for details. Follow and like www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; www.twitter.com/RobinsonsMalls; and @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram.
